reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the outcome. Optional; defaults to an empty string.

checkStatus.description: A single check's outcome, ordered by severity pass < warn < fail.

description: The correctness-gate result for a graph version (ENT-5 / FEAT-3): per-check results, a derived overall verdict, and a block-deploy flag. Mirrored by zetta::ValidationReport in include/zetta/validation.hpp and enforced by validation_report_from_json() in src/core/validation.cpp — keep the three in sync.

block_deploy.description: The gate's deploy policy for this report. Independent of the verdict so a gate can block on a warning (strict) or allow a deploy despite a failure (signed-off override).

verdict.description: Derived: the worst status across checks (an empty list is "pass"). Emitted for readability; advisory on input — when present it must equal the verdict computed from the checks.

title: ValidationReport
